chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Muhammad ibn Uthman, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the souls of the Believers, so he (peace be upon him) said: '(They are) in chambers in Paradise, eating from its food and drinking from its drinks, and they are saying: Our Lord! Establish the Hour for us and Accomplish for us what You have promised us, and Join our later ones with our former ones.'
ai.seo_question: Where are the souls of believers located in Paradise and what do they pray for?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) elucidates the intermediate state of the souls of martyrs and righteous believers, who reside in specific chambers within Paradise, enjoying its blessings even before the final resurrection. The supplication 'Join our end to our beginning' reflects the Shia scholarly understanding of the desire for the complete gathering of the entire community of believers, emphasizing the unity of the Ummah across time. This highlights the concept of *Barzakh* not as a place of waiting in isolation, but as a state of active enjoyment and anticipation for the ultimate reunion.
